en.headline: Customs seize 118 kg of live pests and frozen rats at Man Kam To
en.dek: A 40-year-old local driver was arrested after officers found undeclared mealworms, cockroaches, fruit flies and frozen domestic rats mixed with declared goods.
body: Hong Kong Customs intercepted an inbound goods vehicle at the Man Kam To Control Point on 20 August and seized about 118 kilograms of suspected smuggled live plant pests and frozen pet food valued at roughly HK$35,000.

The haul included mealworms, moth larvae, fruit flies, cockroaches and frozen domestic rats, which officers said had been deliberately mixed with other declared cargo. A 40-year-old local male driver was arrested at the scene.

Customs has passed the seized items to the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department for further investigation. The department reminded the public that importing unmanifested cargo carries a maximum fine of HK$2 million and seven years’ imprisonment, while illegal importation of animals or plant pests attracts additional penalties under separate ordinances.

zh.headline: 海關文錦渡檢118公斤活體病蟲害及冷藏白老鼠
zh.dek: 入境貨車混藏麥皮蟲、蟑螂、果蠅及冷藏白老鼠，40歲本地男司機被捕，市值約3.5萬元。
body: 香港海關8月20日在文錦渡管制站截查一輛入境貨車，檢獲約118公斤懷疑走私活體植物病蟲害及冷藏寵物食物，估計市值約3.5萬元。
檢獲物品包括麥皮蟲、飛蛾幼蟲、果蠅、蟑螂及冷藏白老鼠，與其他已申報貨物混雜。一名40歲本地男司機當場被捕。
海關已將檢獲物品交予漁農自然護理署跟進。海關提醒，輸入或輸出未列艙單貨物最高可被判罰款200萬元及監禁七年；非法輸入動物或植物病蟲害亦分別受《狂犬病規例》及《植物（進口管制及病蟲害控制）條例》規管。
